text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for the congratulations♪ 
These heart-patterned ear ornaments are 
totally my style♡

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's 100-mile Love-chan, right?♪ The 
moment I saw it, it just clicked with me~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I am glad to hear that you like it...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I did consider a long shot, but... I 
thought it best to play it safe and go 
with the favorite—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A long shot? Huh, what's that? What's 
that??

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned doing a birthday stream, 
right? The two of us drew a custom frame 
for it!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
However, no matter what, it couldn't 
surpass amateur-level drawing, so we ended 
up deciding against it...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Still though, yours was a pretty good 
match in terms of Love-chan energy too~. 
Look, like this!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hold on just a sec~ —Aaand done!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
So it's modeled after me running in a 
race... The attention to detail with the 
props is just like Chrono-chan. And the 
sun is Gran-chan. What a cute 'good 
morning mile'♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's even better this way! I love the 
handmade feel! Aaah, jeez... Both the 
earrings and the frame are totally, 
totally my favorite! ♡
